candidate_law: For every one of the 159 frozen source lift events, let (x0,y0) be the centered integral lift of S. In lexicographic order enumerate kx,ky,kA from [-1,0,1]^3. Set x=x0+kx*p, y=y0+ky*p, A=-1+kA*p, B=y^2-x^3-A*x, T=(x,y), P=bT, R=-aT. Preserve every one of 27 attempts, including failures and source negative controls.
selection_score: Minimize the maximum numerator-or-denominator bit length among both coordinates of P and R; break ties by lexicographic (kx,ky,kA). The centered baseline is (0,0,0).
correctness: Require E/Q nonsingular with good reduction to y^2=x^3-x-2 mod p, aP+bR=O, red(P)=U, and red(R)=V exactly for the source positive events; source negative controls must have red(R) != V.
measurement: exact representation-size and candidate-operation comparison on frozen events; wall time is exploratory and no online DLP speed claim is made
